issue: GBK Chinese report headers decoded with Windows-1252 did not match field aliases
fix: Try strict GB18030 after UTF-8, before Western fallbacks, only with predominantly Chinese header letters and at least two CJK characters

tests.scope: CSV inspection, field rules and GUI, restoration, masking, batch, Chinese workflow, Excel import and publication
